metadata.label: Leaf 3.2.8 bitmap Thermal Track - logging and wind page sweep
metadata.toolchain: leaf_3_2_8_thermaltest; pinned PlatformIO configuration; exact firmware.bin preserved
metadata.coverage_notes: User reports logging active, enough collected points for a valid wind estimate, then about 10-12 seconds on each page from Navigate through Basic. Capture spans 72.261 seconds. Ten fixed synthetic Thermal Track markers, bitmap rings/erase/markers/pilot, outlined distance labels. BLE enabled; client activity not established. Debug pages enabled but unvisited. Latest IGC preserved separately; this export does not record wind estimate validity or its value.
metadata.sd_card: Connected Leaf SD card; model/capacity not recorded
metadata.limitations: Short exploratory manual sweep, 23-32 normal renders per page; not a release assessment. Prior runtime_6 had different GPS activity/arrival phase, shorter duration, debug setting and unconfirmed flight logging/wind conditions. Descriptive before/after only; no matched-baseline speedup attribution. Render times include SPI wait, raster drawing and transfer.
metadata.flashed_firmware_verified: USB I:/FIRMWARE.BIN SHA256 equals local test build and preserved firmware.bin

notes: Normal slot/page statistics exclude held buttons, button events and recovery. Recovery covers the next two dispatched slots and extends while completion is late or start delay exceeds 1 ms; inspect it separately.
Few samples: the least-sampled slot has 67; tail estimates are preliminary.

GPS summaries include all sentence dispatches, including interactions. Stages are exclusive elapsed times on device (host thread CPU in sim), not isolated CPU costs. UART timestamps observe firmware reads, not wire arrival. Checksum acceptance does not establish a valid position fix.
The first UART sentence(s) contained bytes read before capture; their ingestion timings are partial.
Recent trace wrapped by design; full-run slot aggregates and the worst incident remain available.
Clock-pair, slot-bookkeeping, and memory-sampling costs are reported. Full instrumentation overhead requires an external A/B measurement.
A zero stack reading can mean an unregistered task or no headroom; inspect active task state and raw samples. Positive stack minima skip zero readings.
Stage 1 manual capture: enabled features are not verified workload coverage. Review is required before release.
Memory change is between manual capture endpoints; a negative change alone does not prove a leak. Heap low watermarks include earlier boot activity.
